environment: Codex in-app browser, WebGPU, macOS; real browser shader execution

live_viewer.content: Tex formula with overlapping translucent Circle/Square and variable fill borders

method: Locally served production assets with a test observer for uncaptured GPU errors/render completion. Live test changes the actual Scene renderer DOM control and checks incoming checkpoint state. Player test clicks actual segment chips and dispatches documented navigation keys. Browser accessibility snapshots report completion.
limitations: Functional browser acceptance, not GPU timing, pixel parity, or a substitute for preserved-golden and geometric tests.
